svg.title: Lock and Lambert — clean wordmark
svg.desc: The clean wordmark version of the Lock and Lambert logo. Words only, no trussed bridge ampersand. The ampersand stays in copper for family continuity with the primary lockup; LOCK and LAMBERT are in warm black, letterspaced, in Cormorant Garamond serif. Town pairing in small caps below. Placeholder version generated 2026-05-20.
